title: DayPlay: 30-to-120min SDK Playlist + Probe Recipes
content:
Context:
This is an intentionally compact, task-first playbook for an engineer's first 30–120 minutes with a Redwood SDK integration. The goal: give a prescriptive, reversible set of probes that surface pain quickly (auth, latency, token accounting, telemetry signals), plus tiny recipes to fix the five most common failure modes. Use in workshops, repl labs, and customer POC handoffs.

Why "DayPlay"?
- Short, sequenced items (like a playlist) for fast feedback.
- Probes (mini tests) that expose infra/contract mismatches early.

Section A — 0–30 min: first-run sanity
Checklist (do in order):
- Create API key & confirm env var (REDWOOD_API_KEY).
- Run: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","prompt":"hello"}' 
- Confirm 200 + streaming chunks (if using stream).
- Check token breakdown header X-Redwood-Tokens and confirm numbers roughly match prompt+output.
- Open local dev console: see SDK log level=debug, confirm request/response timing within 200ms baseline for micro-requests.

Quick probes to run (commands/snippets):
- Node: node -e "require('redwood-sdk').generate({model:'gpt-lite', prompt:'hi'})"
- Python: python -c "from redwood import client; print(client.generate('short test'))"

Section B — 30–60 min: telemetry & guardrails
What to assert in telemetry:
- event: sdk.request.start (fields: route, model, expected_seq_len_hint)
- event: sdk.request.end (fields: latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, success=true|false)
- event: sdk.cache.hit/miss (keys: cache_key, reason)
- event: sdk.fallback.triggered (fields: from_model, to_model, reason)

Small experiment: enable local prefix caching then run 100 short prompts to confirm cache.hit ratio > 60% for repeated prefixes.

Section C — 60–90 min: probe recipes (failure-mode oriented)
1) Auth flake: intermittent 401s - probe: run 10 requests in a loop -> inspect rate of 401s. - recipe: rotate key via dashboard, bump SDK to retry-on-401 middleware (3s backoff), add metric sdk.auth.401.rate.
2) Large outputs truncating - probe: generate with max_tokens=4096 and check X-Redwood-Partial flag. - recipe: enable streaming+resume token fetch, or reduce model sequence_max and switch to chunked decode.
3) Bad latency on warmup - probe: cold-start micro-benchmark (first 5 requests) vs steady-state. - recipe: add warmup preflight, pin model variant (quantized vs fp16) to dedicated pool.
4) Token-cost surprises - probe: run prompt with hidden system messages, check token headers + unit_cost breakdown. - recipe: add token trimming helper in SDK and surface token_preview in console.
5) Unexpected hallucination spikes in eval - probe: run 50 example prompts from eval set and compute F1/QA accuracy. - recipe: pin model->fallback policy, add reranker step, tag rollout as canary.

Section D — micro-templates to copy into SDK README (tiny snippets)
- Minimal quickstart (bash): export REDWOOD_API_KEY=... && curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","prompt":"Summarize: ..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
- Telemetry enable (js): const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, telemetry: {enabled:true, sampleRate:0.2}})

Section E — retention & observability checklist for POC
- Ensure request logs retained for 7d, traces for 14d
- Enable per-route cost sparklines in console for POC customer
- Add smoke test running on CI that asserts generation latency < 500ms (p95)

Section F — suggested tiny experiments for next sprint (2–3 days)
- Add 'prompt preview' toggle that shows token estimates in the SDK UI.
- Implement a simple rerank wrapper in examples/ that chains a small embedder+reranker after generation.
- Create an eval harness notebook (playbook/eval-day.ipynb reference) to run 100-case regression on each model variant.

Open questions / TODOs (notes-to-self):
- What minimum telemetry fields do legal/security want for Private deployments? (ask @Priya)
- Can we expose token_preview without leaking user content to telemetry pipeline? (design with SRE)
- Add a one-click warmup in Dedicated console? (Product ping)

Appendix — short heuristics cheat-sheet:
- If p95 latency spikes when traffic > 20rps -> suspect batching misconfig or wrong pool type.
- If token counts disagree between client and server -> check encoding lib mismatch (utf-8 vs byte-pair tokenizers).
- If hallucinations rise after quantized rollout -> hold canary, run reranker, compare logits/entropy distributions.

End — keep this lean and fork per-customer. Drop into bootcamp sessions as the "DayPlay" worksheet.
